attribution.title: Prins Hendrikkade 33, Amsterdam: stone and yellow-brick office building with a corner belvedere (1921; rijksmonument 518433), now the art'otel
attribution.author: Map Recall
attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry on the 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell (CC BY 4.0) of BAG pand 0363100012170961 (CC0): the open round belvedere with its balustrades, low dome and lantern over the rounded corner, the segmental-hooded dormers and scrolled stone gables on the attic, the giant brick pilasters with stone capitals, the banded rusticated ground storey, the stone end bays, balustrades and wrought-iron balconies, the entrance bay of number 33 and the art'otel lettering, read from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0). No pixels or meshes imported.
